candidates.name: Bounded current stack observation and historical-state comparison
candidates.kind: useful new read-only user loop; not a repair claim for create-only ingest
candidates.user_loop: Given an explicit repository and bounded ordered PR list, collect current per-PR snapshots, retain head/base/time/raw evidence, show each current outcome and changed historical fields, and report the first unresolved frontier with no merge or topology mutation. A subsequent run after user-authorized fix produces a new report rather than overwriting the first.
reuse: existing stack topology representation only after validating supplied order/ref relationships
existing readiness material and pstack babysit check-mode boundary
minimum_contract_before_code: Use explicit repo/PR identities and a small total query/time cap; do not infer repo identity from global pr-N cards.
Fresh per-PR bracketed snapshots are sequential, not an atomic whole-stack transaction; preserve unknown/changed/partial records.
Comparison must label historical/stored data and collection times; never auto-pass local checklist, move cards, update metadata, merge, retarget or watch.
If no trustworthy stored snapshot is supplied, report comparison unavailable instead of inventing freshness.
acceptance_scenarios: Old green H1 versus current H2 pending must display changed binding and pending, never reuse H1 green.
A failed/partial API read retains available facets and unknown outcome; one failed PR cannot disappear from aggregate.
Merged bottom PR plus open dependent PR identifies next frontier only with explicit current base/ref evidence; no automatic retarget.
All clear report remains no_observed_blocker with merge_authorized:false, not READY authorization.
Same immutable inputs rerun to a new output after fixture status correction gives observable red/waiting to clear comparison; no DB required.
candidates.limits: Do not transplant upstream default-drive loops, retry heuristics or owner-gate special cases wholesale. This is a single-pass bounded tool, not full PS17/18.

candidates.name: Opt-in refresh of stored PR observations without resetting human work
candidates.kind: deferred follow-on capability, not an existing-contract bug fix
candidates.user_loop: User explicitly refreshes an identified PR card; current pinned observation is retained and only observation metadata is updated, then runbook distinguishes fresh observation from human checklist state.
candidates.priority_reason: More moving parts than read-only observation: stored identity, compare-and-set, provenance, and failure semantics must be agreed before writes. Rank below candidate1.
minimum_contract_before_code: Require explicit stable repository+PR+card/board identity; current pr-N/meta fields do not prove cross-repo uniqueness.
Do not update on head/base drift, query failure or identity mismatch without recording the unavailable/changed result; never replace old facts with guessed success.
Preserve manual checks, status, assignee, comments and topology; identical observation should not flood events.
Record observed_at and head/base OIDs; mutable branch names alone cannot prove freshness.
acceptance_scenarios: Refresh stored pending→success updates only observation fields with retained previous evidence.
Manual CI checklist fail and blocked lane survive a successful forge observation.
Wrong repo/card collision and concurrent card revision reject without partial updates.
Identical reread produces no duplicate observation/event, while a real changed binding is visible.
candidates.limits: Requires a separately authorized isolated DB exercise when implemented; none performed here. Not a continuous watch or merge service.
